reg_deadline.en: Online, by mail or at your county clerk's office: your clerk must receive it by 5 p.m. on Friday, October 23, 2026. After that, you can register in person when you vote, during early voting or on Election Day, with two forms of ID.
reg_deadline.es: En línea, por correo o en la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk): debe recibirlo a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 23 de octubre de 2026. Después de esa fecha, puedes registrarte en persona cuando vayas a votar, durante la votación anticipada o el Día de las Elecciones, con dos formas de identificación.
reg_deadline.quote: For the November 3rd, 2026 Regular General Election, your county clerk must receive your registration by 5:00 pm on Friday, October 23rd, 2026.
reg_deadline.en_after: The regular deadline was October 23, 2026. You can still register in person when you vote, at an early voting location or on Election Day, with two forms of ID.
reg_deadline.es_after: La fecha límite regular fue el 23 de octubre de 2026. Todavía puedes registrarte en persona cuando vayas a votar, en un lugar de votación anticipada o el Día de las Elecciones, con dos formas de identificación.

mail_request.en: Active voters get a ballot in the mail without asking. The last day to request a ballot is 5 p.m. on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.
mail_request.es: Los votantes activos reciben su boleta por correo sin pedirla. El último día para solicitar una boleta es el martes 27 de octubre de 2026 a las 5 p. m.
mail_request.en_after: Requests closed at 5 p.m. on October 27. You can still vote in person, early on the days your county sets or on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes cerraron a las 5 p. m. del 27 de octubre. Todavía puedes votar en persona, por anticipado en los días que fije tu condado o el Día de las Elecciones.

mail_return.en: Drop box or polling place: by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Mail: your county clerk must receive it by 8 p.m. that day. A postmark isn't enough, and ballots that arrive after November 3 don't count.
mail_return.es: Buzón de entrega o lugar de votación: a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Por correo: la oficina del secretario de tu condado debe recibirla a más tardar a las 8 p. m. de ese día. El matasellos no basta, y las boletas que llegan después del 3 de noviembre no cuentan.
mail_return.quote: Your mail ballot must received by the clerk’s office on or before 8:00 p.m. on Election Day, November 3, 2026. Ballots received after November 3, 2026 will not be counted.

early_hours.en: Each county sets its own early voting days, hours and places, and some keep going after Friday, October 30. Utah County, for example, votes early October 26 to 30 and on Monday, November 2, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., at the Health and Justice Building in Provo. Look up your county's schedule at vote.utah.gov.
early_hours.es: Cada condado fija sus propios días, horarios y lugares de votación anticipada, y algunos siguen después del viernes 30 de octubre. El condado de Utah, por ejemplo, tiene votación anticipada del 26 al 30 de octubre y el lunes 2 de noviembre, de 8 a. m. a 5 p. m., en el Health and Justice Building de Provo. Busca el horario de tu condado en vote.utah.gov.
early_hours.quote: Early Voting will be available at the Health and Justice Building located at 151 S University Ave, Ste 2500, Provo, UT 84606 from 8AM to 5PM on Monday, October 26th to Friday, October 30th, as well as on Monday, November 2nd.
early_hours.en_after: Early voting has ended. On Election Day, polling locations are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó. El Día de las Elecciones, los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m.
early_hours.notes: Utah Code 20A-3a-601 (read 2026-10-28): the default period runs from 14 days before through the Friday before; '(3)(a) An election officer may extend the end of the early voting period to the day before the election date' and (3)(c) a county clerk may reduce it to at least four days. Other county schedules seen: Salt Lake County Government Center adds Saturday, October 31, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. (saltlakecounty.gov early voting page, via search, not opened); Summit County October 28 to 31 (utah.gov public notice, via search, not opened).

cure.notes: The cure deadline is noon on the last business day before the county canvass (Utah Code 20A-3a-401(9)). Counties canvass between November 10 and November 17 (2026 Utah Election Calendar), so there is no single statewide date; the rule is in mail.cure.

in_person.en: Your ballot comes in the mail, but you can also vote in person: early, on the days and at the places your county sets, or on Election Day from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. Every county has at least one Election Day polling location.
in_person.es: Tu boleta llega por correo, pero también puedes votar en persona: por anticipado, en los días y lugares que fije tu condado, o el Día de las Elecciones de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m. Cada condado tiene al menos un lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.
in_person.quote: Eligible voters can vote in-person on Election Day. All counties must have at least one polling location.
in_person.en_after: Your ballot comes in the mail, but you can also vote in person on Election Day from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. Every county has at least one Election Day polling location.
in_person.es_after: Tu boleta te llega por correo, pero también puedes votar en persona el Día de las Elecciones de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m. Cada condado tiene por lo menos un lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.

first_time.en: Registering for the first time and voting by mail? Your county clerk may ask you to put a copy of your ID in the return envelope with your ballot. Check the instructions that come with it.
first_time.es: ¿Te registras por primera vez y votas por correo? La oficina del secretario de tu condado puede pedirte que metas una copia de tu identificación en el sobre de devolución junto con tu boleta. Revisa las instrucciones que vienen con ella.
first_time.quote: if required by the election officer because the voter has not yet provided valid voter identification with the voter's voter registration record, include a copy of the voter's valid voter identification with the ballot inside the return envelope;

locator_label.en: How and Where Can I Vote? (vote.utah.gov)
locator_label.es: Dónde y cómo votar, búsqueda por dirección (vote.utah.gov)

rule.en: Look up early voting locations and times, drop boxes and your Election Day polling location at vote.utah.gov. Your county clerk can also tell you where to vote or drop off your ballot.
rule.es: Busca los lugares y horarios de votación anticipada, los buzones de entrega y tu lugar de votación del Día de las Elecciones en vote.utah.gov. La oficina del secretario de tu condado también te puede decir dónde votar o dejar tu boleta.
rule.quote: Contact your clerk’s office to find a location to cast or drop off your ballot on Election Day.

en: ID card issued by the state of Utah or the U.S. government
Currently valid U.S. military ID card
es: Tarjeta de identificación emitida por el estado de Utah o el gobierno de EE. UU.
Permiso de portación oculta de armas de Utah (concealed carry permit)
Identificación militar de EE. UU. vigente
Tarjeta de identificación tribal (no necesita foto)
accepted.quote: ONE primary form of ID that is valid (not expired), has your name, and has your photograph.

expired.en: Your photo ID has to be current, not expired.
expired.es: Tu identificación con foto tiene que estar vigente, no vencida.
expired.quote: ONE primary form of ID that is valid (not expired), has your name, and has your photograph.

without.en: No photo ID? Bring two documents that together prove your name and where you live now, such as a certified birth certificate, a valid Social Security card, a government check, a Medicaid, Medicare or EBT card, or your current Utah vehicle registration. Registering when you vote? You need two IDs: one that proves who you are and one that proves where you live.
without.es: ¿No tienes identificación con foto? Lleva dos documentos que juntos comprueben tu nombre y dónde vives ahora, como un acta de nacimiento certificada, una tarjeta de Seguro Social válida, un cheque del gobierno, una tarjeta de Medicaid, Medicare o EBT, o el registro vigente de tu vehículo en Utah. ¿Te vas a registrar al votar? Necesitas dos identificaciones: una que compruebe quién eres y otra que compruebe dónde vives.
without.quote: If you are not already registered to vote and are voting with a provisional ballot, you will need to show TWO acceptable forms of ID: one that verifies identity AND one for proof of residence.

who.en: Every active voter gets a ballot in the mail. County clerks mail them between October 13 and October 27, 2026. If yours doesn't arrive soon after, call your county clerk's office right away.
who.es: Cada votante activo recibe su boleta por correo. Las oficinas de los secretarios de condado las envían entre el 13 y el 27 de octubre de 2026. Si la tuya no llega poco después, llama de inmediato a la oficina del secretario de tu condado.
who.quote: If you do not receive a ballot shortly after this time, immediately contact your county clerk’s office.

witness.en: Sign the affidavit on the return envelope and write the last four digits of your Utah driver license or state ID card.
witness.es: Firma la declaración jurada del sobre de devolución y escribe los últimos cuatro dígitos de tu licencia de conducir o tarjeta de identificación de Utah.
witness.quote: enter the last four digits of the voter's Utah driver license or Utah state identification card;

cure.en: If your signature or ID number is in question, your county clerk will contact you with an affidavit to sign. It must reach the clerk by noon on the last business day before your county's canvass, and then your ballot counts.
cure.es: Si hay dudas sobre tu firma o tu número de identificación, la oficina del secretario de tu condado se comunicará contigo con una declaración jurada para firmar. Debe llegar a la oficina a más tardar al mediodía del último día hábil antes del escrutinio de tu condado, y entonces tu boleta cuenta.
cure.quote: if the election officer receives the affidavit no later than noon on the last business day before the day of the applicable canvass, count the individual's ballot;

dropbox.en: Drop boxes close at 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Find the one closest to you at vote.utah.gov.
dropbox.es: Los buzones de entrega cierran a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Busca el más cercano en vote.utah.gov.
dropbox.quote: Find the drop box closest to you at vote.utah.gov. Drop boxes close at 8:00 p.m. on Nov. 3.

gear.en: Save the campaigning for later. Within 150 feet of the building where you vote, or where a ballot drop box sits, no one can try to sway votes by word or in print, hand out cards or flyers, or gather petition signatures.
gear.es: Deja la campaña para después. A menos de 150 pies del edificio donde votas, o de donde hay un buzón de entrega de boletas, nadie puede tratar de influir en el voto de palabra o por escrito, repartir tarjetas o volantes, ni juntar firmas para peticiones.
gear.quote: An individual may not, within a polling place or in any public area within 150 feet of the building where a polling place is located:

phone.en: Utah law lets you photograph your own ballot and share the photo, whether you vote by mail or at a polling place. Taking a photo of anyone else's ballot at a polling place is a misdemeanor, and so is interfering with someone who is marking a ballot.
phone.es: La ley de Utah te permite tomarle foto a tu propia boleta y compartir la foto, ya sea que votes por correo o en un lugar de votación. Tomarle foto a la boleta de otra persona en un lugar de votación es un delito menor (misdemeanor), igual que interferir con alguien que está marcando su boleta.
phone.quote: Subsection (1) does not prohibit an individual from transferring a photograph of the individual's own ballot in a manner that allows the photograph to be viewed by the individual or another.
phone.notes: Same section (1)(e): class C misdemeanor to take 'a photograph of a ballot, other than the individual's own ballot, at a polling place'; (1)(c) interfering with an individual inside the voting booth or marking a ballot. Read 2026-10-28 in Chrome.

line.en: In line at 8 p.m.? Stay in line. At a polling place you can still vote, and at a ballot drop box you can still drop off your sealed ballot.
line.es: ¿Estás en la fila a las 8 p. m.? No te salgas. En un lugar de votación todavía puedes votar, y en un buzón todavía puedes dejar tu boleta en su sobre cerrado.
line.quote: in line at a polling place, is allowed to vote.

tradition.en: For 2026, Weber County Elections held an America 250 "I Voted" sticker contest for local high school students. The winner is Hailey, a 10th grader at Ben Lomond High School, and her design goes to voters through the 2026 election cycle. Statewide, vote.utah.gov still offers four printable 2020 "I Voted" stickers.
tradition.es: Para 2026, la oficina electoral del condado de Weber organizó un concurso de stickers de "I Voted" de America 250 para estudiantes de preparatoria. La ganadora es Hailey, estudiante de 10.º grado en Ben Lomond High School, y su diseño se entrega a los votantes durante el ciclo electoral de 2026. A nivel estatal, vote.utah.gov todavía ofrece cuatro stickers de "I Voted" de 2020 para imprimir.
tradition.quote: Congratulations to Hailey, a 10th-grade student at Ben Lomond High School, whose design was chosen as this year's winning "I Voted" sticker!
tradition.notes: Weber's page gives first name and school only. The 2020 printable stickers: https://vote.utah.gov/stickers/ ('Click here to download all four 2020 “I Voted” stickers', read 2026-10-21). Utah County's 2026 America 250 student winner was not found on vote.utahcounty.gov or utahcounty.gov (only in news), so it is left out. Spanish avoids a gendered word for the winner.

provisional.en: If you register after October 23, you vote a provisional ballot. If you vote a provisional ballot without showing ID, you have until Monday, November 9, 2026, to show it to your county clerk.
provisional.es: Si te registras después del 23 de octubre, votas con una boleta provisional. Si votas con una boleta provisional sin mostrar identificación, tienes hasta el lunes 9 de noviembre de 2026 para mostrarla en la oficina del secretario de tu condado.
provisional.quote: Last day that the voter can provide ID to the election officer, if they didn’t when voting provisionally 20A-4-107(1)

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone in line at a polling place by 8 p.m. on Election Day gets to vote, and anyone in line at a drop box by 8 p.m. with a sealed ballot gets to drop it in.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Cualquier persona que esté en la fila de un lugar de votación a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones puede votar, y quien esté en la fila de un buzón de entrega a las 8 p. m. con su boleta sellada puede depositarla.
line.quote: in line at a ballot drop box, with a sealed return envelope containing a ballot in the voter's possession, is allowed to deposit the ballot in the ballot drop box; or

track.en: Sign up at vote.utah.gov to be told when your ballot is sent and counted, or check its status there anytime.
track.es: Inscríbete en vote.utah.gov para que te avisen cuando envíen y cuenten tu boleta, o revisa su estado ahí cuando quieras.
track.quote: Sign up to be notified when your mail-in ballot is sent and counted.

unsigned.notes: 20A-3a-401 sets the cure process for a questioned signature or ID number; whether a fully unsigned envelope can be cured was not stated in the parts read.

late_mail.en: A mailed ballot counts only if your county clerk receives it by 8 p.m. on November 3, whatever the postmark. If it's late, use a drop box or take it to a polling location instead.
late_mail.es: Una boleta por correo cuenta solo si la oficina del secretario de tu condado la recibe a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre, sin importar el matasellos. Si ya es tarde, usa un buzón de entrega o llévala a un lugar de votación.
late_mail.quote: Ballots received after Nov. 3 will not be counted, regardless of when they are postmarked.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on vote.utah.gov (curl worked: current-election-information, learn-about-registering-to-vote, learn-about-voting-by-mail-and-absentee-voting, voter-id-requirements, securing-your-mail-ballot, track-my-ballot, stickers, the 2026 Utah Election Calendar PDF and the 2026 Voter Information Pamphlet PDF) and le.utah.gov (20A-1-102 valid voter ID, 20A-1-302 hours, 20A-3a-204, 20A-3a-401, 20A-3a-501, 20A-3a-601). EARLY VOTING for states.js: Tuesday, October 20 to Friday, October 30, 2026. Pamphlet: 'VOTE EARLY IN-PERSON (October 20th - October 30th) All counties conduct early voting, although times and locations vary.' Calendar marks 'In-person early voting period begins' on Tuesday, October 20. Utah Code 20A-3a-601(2): the period 'begins on the date that is 14 calendar days before the date of the election; and continues through the Friday before the election if the election date is a Tuesday'; 601(3)(a) lets an election officer extend it to the day before the election, and 601(4)(b) requires early voting 'on each weekday'. Source URL: https://vote.utah.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/2026-Voter-Information-Pamphlet.pdf. ID: the vote.utah.gov ID page's two-document list omits the paycheck that Code 20A-1-102(84)(c)(iv) and the pamphlet include; the statute is cited for id.without. Sticker: the 2020 printable stickers are the only official sticker page found. Utah County ran a 2026 student 'I Voted' sticker contest (reported by KSL and Lehi Free Press), but utahcounty.gov/Elections/kids/ returned HTTP 500, so it is not used. The mail_request deadline is from the current-election page; the page does not say who needs to request (it also says active voters are mailed one automatically).

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: Polls at all elections on the date of the election shall open at 7 a.m. and shall remain open until 8 p.m. of the same day.
